summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload via bundled Bun
details: @ornikar/prismic-components@0.0.4 is a lure package with no component code. package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` and points `main` at a non-existent `index.js`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip`, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a rotating string-array decoder (`WV8StW`/`hc1jfK9`) and hex-mangled identifiers. The payload has no readable content consistent with a Prismic components package. Using an alternate runtime (Bun) to execute an opaque bundled payload evades Node-based static analysis and lifecycle-script sandboxing, resulting in arbitrary code execution on any host that runs `npm install` for this package. The `@ornikar` scope, placeholder metadata (empty description/author), and absent library entry point are consistent with a scope-impersonation delivery vehicle targeting a corporate namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
